notes: Sejmik storey must hold hall (≤100 seats, amphitheatre), lobby, media room, control room, catering, 2 committee + 4 club rooms → ~1,100 m² net ≈ 1,400 m² gross, but zone A gives only ≈1,180 m². Working solution: 7.5 m Sejmik storey with a mezzanine (antresola = part of the same storey per WT §3) carrying the public gallery with its own entrance — turning a constraint into the required civic separation.
Massing logic: tower P+8+Sejmik ≈ 42 m in zone A; perimeter wings P+5 ≈ 24 m (18–25 m band) along Mazowiecka to No. 19; cornice line ≈ 21 m to match neighbours (heritage).

Neighbour protection: gable windows of Słowackiego 5 face north → §13 obstruction rule governs (no obstacle within ½ obstruction height in a 60° sector; ≥17.5 m from the tower); §60: both equinoxes, 1.5 h, 7–17 official time.

Budget: first parametric check 142–183 M PLN vs 150 M cap → efficiency is a design driver (compact Sejmik floor, circulation ≤25–30 %, basement sized to MPZP minimum ≈103–110 cars + technical + civil shelter).
Office module 1.35 m → 24 m² room = 3 bays × 5.9 m; 32 m² = 4 bays — same depth, fully interchangeable.
